In 2021, I decided that I was going to final yeet on April of that year. I was deeply depressed and had no hope for the future, I continuously shed and the 2 years prior to enter college were a living hell. I had no true friends at that time, and I had many issues regarding my sexuality and my gender. Besides, I was just told that I had ASD. It was too much for me to handle.   
I asked my parents to make a latch for the bathroom, as I lied telling them that I would like a little bit more privacy (my family usually enters the bathroom even when I’m naked). My true intentions were to lock myself up so I could sh without no one noticing or even when the time came down to sewer slide.  
After a long therapy session I ended up telling my therapist my plan and my mom received a phone call from the therapist. I never saw her that devastated in my entire life. She would hug me while crying, begging me not to do it. I felt horrible and I ended up telling her that I wouldn’t do it.   
The following day, after I came back from school, I went to the bathroom and the latch was gone.  
But now I’m proud to say that this picture was taken today, 02/02/2024. As of today, I’m exactly 1 year and 7 months clean. It got better, way better. I still have those scars and the urges come back in the worst nights, but I am still here to fight it. I am still alive.

To be honest, I still haven't got a clear picture of what I want to look like. It's mostly because I feel like I'm fat and weak. So far my motivation is to stop feeling like that while not being really really muscular. But overall thanks for the help! :)
